# `connectome_vertices`

the connection weights between the vertices of the end surface, from a fiber bundle's ends, with the largest connected component.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run connectome_vertices --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run connectome_vertices --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run connectome_vertices --fibers tracts --end-surface pial --dataset d --subject s [--prune-below 1e-4]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `fibers` | manifold curve, where {"name": "$fibers"} | yes |
| `surface` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$end_surface"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fibers` | `--fibers` | `required` | - |  | the fiber bundle's name |
| `end_surface` | `--end-surface` | `required` | - |  | the surface the fibers' ends are placed on |
| `smooth_hops` | `--smooth-hops` | `3` | hops |  | hops of the mesh smoothing of the vertex matrix (the reference's; 0: the plain fiber counts) |
| `max_end_distance` | `--max-end-distance` | `5` | mm |  | a fiber with an end farther than this from the end surface is left out; none: no gate (the reference) |
| `prune_below` | `--prune-below` | `0.0001` | fraction |  | connection weights below this fraction of the strongest are removed (0: none) |
| `n_vertices` | `--n-vertices` | `0` | vertices |  | the end surface's vertex count (read from the surface when 0) |
| `points_per_fiber` | `--points-per-fiber` | `0` | points |  | the points of each fiber (read from the bundle when 0) |
| `name` | `--name` | `{fibers}_{end_surface}_connection_weights_h{smooth_hops}` | - |  | the stored name of the connection weights |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`meeg.fiber_ends`](../nodes.md) | fibers=fibers | points_per_fiber=$points_per_fiber | end_points |
| before | [`meeg.nearest_vertex`](../nodes.md) | points=end_points, positions=surface |  | end_vertex, end_distance |
| before | [`meeg.end_gate`](../nodes.md) | end_distance=end_distance | max_end_distance_mm=$max_end_distance | keep |
| before | [`meeg.end_connectome`](../nodes.md) | end_vertex=end_vertex, keep=keep | n_vertices=$n_vertices | fiber_counts |
| before | [`meeg.connection_weights`](../nodes.md) | fiber_counts=fiber_counts, faces=surface | smooth_hops=$smooth_hops | weights |
| before | [`meeg.prune_below`](../nodes.md) | connection_weights=weights | prune_below=$prune_below | pruned |
| before | [`meeg.largest_component`](../nodes.md) | connection_weights=pruned |  | component_vertices, component_label |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `pruned` | kind field, name $name, kind_name connectome, on surface x surface, unit fibers, description the connection weights, SPARSE (CSC), on the product manifold surface x surface |
| `component_vertices` | kind selection, type indices, name {name}_component, on surface, description the vertices of the largest connected component of the connection weights |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE MATERIALISED VERTEX CONNECTOME (spec section 4.3), on request only: the vertex matrix of fiber counts smoothed over the mesh (smoothing . counts . smoothing^T, the diagonal
removed), weak connections pruned, and the largest connected component. Pruning and the largest component belong to a materialised connectome only, so they are not options of the
partition definitions. The matrix is large (10^5 fibers: about 1.6 GB in float64 before pruning): this is the only place it is formed. Stored: a `field` on the product manifold
surface x surface, SPARSE (its entries: row, column, value; the matrix's shape in the producer record), and the selection of the largest component's vertices (`indices`).

  nxr-neuro run connectome_vertices --fibers tracts --end-surface pial --dataset d --subject s [--prune-below 1e-4]
```
